items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs (finger) inactive for Wednesday vs Rams; limited all week but unlikely per coach comments.
items.implication: Committee of Kaleb Johnson/MarShawn Lloyd/Chris Brooks handles carries.
items.opportunity: Elevated early-down work for backups; Packers run game remains weak.

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III for Thursday night vs Bills due to groin injury; rookie Emmett Johnson will start for the third straight game.
items.why: Groin injury; not quite ready after limited practices then DNP.
items.implication: Emmett Johnson gets another lead role start; Walker misses third straight.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for Johnson and Chiefs RBs behind him.

items.text: Micah Parsons officially active for Packers vs Rams Wednesday night after activation from PUP.
items.why: Cleared and activated; expected ~50% snaps in return from knee.
items.implication: Boosts Packers defense; Zaire Franklin inactive opposite.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving this week: since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC average more PPG among RBs; gets Carolina matchup.
items.why: Elite recent PPG + soft CAR matchup.
items.opportunity: Continued high usage vs weak run D.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries; shaping up as possible GTD.
items.implication: Monitor closely; could limit or sideline for Week 12; next-man-up elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased role for Jaguars RB depth if limited/out.

items.text: Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% and 4.5 rec/game in 2 games with Brissett (from <6%/1.3); raises PPR floor.
items.implication: Higher floor in PPR; LOVE for volume.

items.text: Jaylen Warren only 51% rush attempts since Dowdle return, low targets (RB20 util); D'Andre Swift 47% snaps/39% rushes with Monangai back, low targets—both mid/low RB2s now.
Puka Nacua and TE Terrance Ferguson out for the season (knee/toe and ankle/hamstring).
items.why: Confirmed season-ending injuries in Week 12 preview.
items.implication: Rams WR depth thinned further; Adams longshot timeline separate.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Rams pass-catchers like Kyren support or others.

items.text: Bo Nix on HATE list this week: expecting lots of Jonah Coleman vs PIT; not enough rushing from Nix; outside top 20.
items.why: Coleman usage spike without Harvey; Nix limited rushing upside.

items.text: On Travis Etienne: could see disappointing snaps/routes down the stretch but reasonably high carry count; favorable ARZ/ATL in Weeks 16/17.
items.why: Citing Graziano report on situation; volume split expected.
items.implication: Carry floor keeps him viable but route/snap share limits ceiling; playoff schedule boost.
items.opportunity: Solid carry volume floor if healthy; monitor role with Saints/NO changes.

items.text: DeVonta Smith saw 57% target share in Week 11; averages 36% on season, 50% end-zone targets; role elite despite injuries.
items.why: Massive target dominance even with Hurts issues.
items.implication: WR1 upside if healthy; ride-or-die validated.

items.text: Ladd McConkey season-high 38% target share and 20.7 FP in return; when 20%+ share averages 17.5 PPG.
items.implication: Solid WR option if stays healthy (big if).

items.text: Trey McBride 39% target share (19 targets) over 2 weeks with new QBs but aDOT only 3 yards, 1/19 10+ air yards; volume keeps top-5 TE but efficiency down to 11.8 PPG.
items.why: Short aDOT with backup QBs vs prior Brissett.
items.implication: PPR volume safe but not elite ceiling anymore.
items.opportunity: High target share persists; low aDOT caps YAC/big plays.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka last among 45 WRs with 50+ targets in YPT (5.0); under 50 rec yds since Week 3; under 12 PPR in 17/20 recent games.
